fields.statement: Verifier claude-code-095db8db at c58c8ead (attempt 2): go test -trimpath -count=1 ./cmd/rhiza -run TestScripts/plan-milestone-interview-waiting passed: inside a fake rex (REX_BLOCK set) with fake claude, the non-autonomous milestone run's stderr carries exactly one state=blocked:kind=question:app=rhiza report whose msg decodes to 'interview waits on you in tab ...: the milestone interview waits on you', ordered working, blocked, done (before the fake agent asks anything), while the feature plan run and the autonomous milestone run carry no state=blocked. go test -trimpath -count=1 ./internal/api -run TestProgramStatusMilestoneInterview passed: milestoneInterviewLaunch is true only for a non-autonomous milestone plan's interview step, and launchBlocked encodes a blocked question naming the milestone interview, cleared by the next step's status. Read both leaf commits' diffs (4805285b, c58c8ead): the report is written only through ctx.Rex (driver inside Rex), matching the narrowed statement. go test ./internal/run and ./internal/api (skipping the TestReadBudget timing budget, which failed only on what-if latency under contention) pass; go vet and gofmt clean.
